mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly GDP growth rate exceeding 0.5% in GDPC1 signals robust economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings expectations and compressing equity risk premiums, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 quarterly growth rate exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 250.2 indicates accelerating inflation, triggering preemptive monetary tightening by the Fed that increases real interest rates and equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250.2.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in INDPRO (industrial production) and RSAFS (retail sales) exceeding 2% signal a synchronized demand-supply contraction, reducing corporate revenue visibility and increasing equity volatility, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when both INDPRO and RSAFS decline >2%.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE below 4.0% indicates tight labor market conditions that sustain wage growth and consumer spending, increasing corporate profit margins and equity valuations, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO exceeding 1% signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate output capacity and earnings growth forecasts, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO declines >1%.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST below 1320 indicates weak housing market demand, reducing construction sector activity and consumer confidence, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 1320.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 250.2 combined with FEDFUNDS below 2.0% signals inflationary pressure without sufficient monetary response, increasing real rate uncertainty and equity risk premiums, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250.2 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: A GDPC1 quarterly revision exceeding 15% indicates upward GDP growth reassessment, boosting corporate earnings forecasts and equity market confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 revision > 15%.
